response.text: Driverless vehicles are subject to the same laws as other vehicles, but many traffic and parking rules were written for a human driver, so tickets must be issued to a human driver for many offences. Owner liability (ticketing the vehicle owner) already exists for many non-moving violations such as parking, stopping and standing, and for red-light camera enforcement [3]. Moving violations are primarily governed by provincial legislation, and changes to enforcement or liability for fully driverless vehicles would require provincial consideration [3][4].
